// subsystems/typology/tests/schematics/channels.test.js
import { specimen, v } from "@vivalence/typology";

const { Channel, Channels, Faculty } = v.primitives.hallucination;

const faults = (schema, value) => [...v.faults(schema, value)];

const refused = (schema, value) => faults(schema, value).length > 0;

const ear = {
  type: "verbatim",
  id: "nova-3",
  tune: [0.9, 0.2, 0.9],
  channels: {
    stream: {
      in: [{ type: "audio", mime: ["audio/pcm;rate=16000;channels=1"] }],
      out: [{ type: "text" }],
      via: () => {},
    },
    render: {
      in: [
        {
          type: "audio",
          mime: ["audio/ogg", "audio/mpeg", "audio/mp4", "audio/aac"],
          bytes: 26214400,
        },
      ],
      out: [{ type: "text" }],
      via: () => {},
    },
  },
};

const painter = {
  type: "picture",
  id: "openai/gpt-image-2",
  tune: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
  channels: {
    render: {
      in: [{ type: "text" }, { type: "image", mime: ["image/png", "image/jpeg"], count: 16 }],
      out: [{ type: "image", mime: ["image/png"] }],
      via: () => {},
    },
  },
};

specimen.describe("Channel — one kind a faculty takes or gives", () => {
  specimen.it("a kind alone is a channel: every media type, any size, any count", () => {
    specimen.expect(faults(Channel, { type: "text" })).toEqual([]);
  });

  specimen.it("mime lists media types, parameters included", () => {
    const channel = { type: "audio", mime: ["audio/ogg;codecs=opus"] };
    specimen.expect(faults(Channel, channel)).toEqual([]);
  });

  specimen.it("bytes bounds one part, count bounds the parts of a request", () => {
    specimen.expect(faults(Channel, { type: "image", bytes: 5242880, count: 16 })).toEqual([]);
    specimen.expect(faults(Channel, { type: "image", count: 0 })).toEqual([]);
  });

  specimen.it("refuses a kind that is no part, a mime that is no media type, zero bytes", () => {
    specimen.expect(refused(Channel, { type: "file" })).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(refused(Channel, { type: "audio", mime: ["pcm_16000"] })).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(refused(Channel, { type: "audio", mime: "audio/ogg" })).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(refused(Channel, { type: "image", bytes: 0 })).toBe(true);
  });

  specimen.it("refuses a key of its own invention: rate, codec, codecs, packets", () => {
    for (const key of ["rate", "codec", "codecs", "packets"])
      specimen.expect([key, refused(Channel, { type: "audio", [key]: 1 })]).toEqual([key, true]);
  });

  specimen.it("refuses the old form, a bare kind", () => {
    specimen.expect(refused(Channel, "text")).toBe(true);
  });
});

specimen.describe("Channels — in, out and the call, by via", () => {
  specimen.it("one via, both vias, each with its own lists", () => {
    specimen.expect(faults(Channels, painter.channels)).toEqual([]);
    specimen.expect(faults(Channels, ear.channels)).toEqual([]);
  });

  specimen.it("a via with one side missing is refused", () => {
    const stream = { in: [{ type: "text" }], via: () => {} };
    specimen.expect(refused(Channels, { stream })).toBe(true);
  });

  specimen.it("a via without its call is refused, and the fault names the via", () => {
    const render = { in: [{ type: "text" }], out: [{ type: "text" }] };
    specimen.expect(faults(Channels, { render })).toEqual([
      { at: "/render", reason: "must have required properties via" },
    ]);
  });

  specimen.it("refuses the old form, in and out on the faculty", () => {
    specimen.expect(refused(Channels, { in: ["text"], out: ["text"] })).toBe(true);
  });

  specimen.it("refuses a via that does not exist", () => {
    specimen.expect(refused(Channels, { live: { in: [], out: [], via: () => {} } })).toBe(true);
  });
});

specimen.describe("Faculty — channels are part of what a faculty is, its vias inside", () => {
  specimen.it("a verbatim faculty of two vias, a painter of one", () => {
    specimen.expect(faults(Faculty, ear)).toEqual([]);
    specimen.expect(faults(Faculty, painter)).toEqual([]);
  });

  specimen.it("a faculty without channels is refused, and the fault names the key", () => {
    const { channels, ...bare } = ear;
    specimen.expect(faults(Faculty, bare)).toEqual([
      { at: "/", reason: "must have required properties channels" },
    ]);
  });

  specimen.it("a faculty that keeps via beside its channels still checks: the key is not read", () => {
    specimen.expect(faults(Faculty, { ...painter, via: { render: () => {} } })).toEqual([]);
  });

  specimen.it("a fault names its path down to the media type", () => {
    const render = {
      in: [{ type: "audio", mime: ["audio/ogg", "mp3_44100_128"] }],
      out: [],
      via: () => {},
    };
    specimen.expect(faults(Faculty, { ...ear, channels: { render } })).toEqual([
      {
        at: "/channels/render/in/0/mime/1",
        reason: "must be RFC 2045 media type with parameters (type/subtype;name=value)",
      },
    ]);
  });

  specimen.it("the source is not mutated", () => {
    specimen.expect(ear.channels.render.in[0].mime).toEqual([
      "audio/ogg",
      "audio/mpeg",
      "audio/mp4",
      "audio/aac",
    ]);
  });
});

// subsystems/typology/tests/cortex.test.js:257
   });
 });

+specimen.describe("Cortex.register — a faculty declares its channels, each via inside", () => {
+  const render = async () => ({});
+  const WORDS = { in: [{ type: "text" }], out: [{ type: "text" }] };
+  const refused = (faculty) => {
+    try {
+      const plain = { type: "dialogue", id: "plain", tune: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], ...faculty };
+      new Cortex().register([plain]);
+    } catch (fault) {
+      return fault.message;
+    }
+  };
+
+  specimen.it("a faculty without channels is refused", () => {
+    specimen.expect(refused({})).toBe(
+      "[cortex] invalid faculty /: must have required properties channels",
+    );
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("a channel in the string grammar is refused", () => {
+    const stringed = { render: { in: ["text"], out: ["text"], via: render } };
+    specimen.expect(refused({ channels: stringed })).toBe(
+      "[cortex] invalid faculty /channels/render/in/0: must be object",
+    );
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("a faculty-wide list, a foreign key, a mime that is none: each refused", () => {
+    const taking = (channel) => ({
+      channels: { render: { in: [channel], out: [], via: render } },
+    });
+    specimen.expect(refused({ channels: WORDS })).toContain("/channels");
+    specimen.expect(refused(taking({ type: "audio", codec: "pcm_16000" }))).toContain(
+      "/channels/render/in/0",
+    );
+    specimen.expect(refused(taking({ type: "audio", mime: ["ogg"] }))).toContain(
+      "/channels/render/in/0/mime/0",
+    );
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("a via is its channels: one without its call is refused, the old key too", () => {
+    specimen.expect(refused({ channels: { render: WORDS } })).toBe(
+      "[cortex] invalid faculty /channels/render: must have required properties via",
+    );
+    specimen.expect(refused({ channels: { render: { ...WORDS, via: render } }, via: { render } }))
+      .toBe(undefined);
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("find by via reads the channels: a faculty of one via is not found on the other", () => {
+    const cortex = new Cortex().register([
+      { type: "dialogue", id: "plain", tune: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], channels: { render: { ...WORDS, via: render } } },
+    ]);
+    specimen.expect(cortex.find({ type: "dialogue", via: "render" }).map((faculty) => faculty.id))
+      .toEqual(["plain"]);
+    specimen.expect(cortex.find({ type: "dialogue", via: "stream" })).toEqual([]);
+    specimen.expect(cortex.findOne({ type: "dialogue", via: "render" }).channels.render.via)
+      .toBe(render);
+  });
+});
+

#+begin_src diff
// subsystems/typology/tests/schematics/mime.test.js:21
   });
 });

+specimen.describe("mime.media — a media type that may carry parameters", () => {
+  const taken = [
+    "audio/ogg",
+    "audio/ogg;codecs=opus",
+    "audio/ogg; codecs=opus",
+    "audio/pcm;rate=16000;channels=1",
+    'audio/mp4; codecs="mp4a.40.2"',
+    "application/vnd.viva.dom.svelte+javascript",
+  ];
+  const refused = [
+    "ogg",
+    "audio/",
+    "audio/ogg;",
+    "audio/ogg;codecs",
+    "audio/ogg;codecs=",
+    "sound/ogg",
+    "audio/ogg codecs=opus",
+  ];
+  const checked = (value) => [value, mime.media().check(value)];
+
+  specimen.it("takes a bare type, and a type with one or more name=value parameters", () => {
+    for (const value of taken) specimen.expect(checked(value)).toEqual([value, true]);
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("refuses a parameter without a value, a trailing semicolon, an unknown type", () => {
+    for (const value of refused) specimen.expect(checked(value)).toEqual([value, false]);
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("mime.type stays strict: of these it takes only the two without a parameter", () => {
+    specimen.expect(taken.filter((value) => mime.type().check(value))).toEqual([
+      "audio/ogg",
+      "application/vnd.viva.dom.svelte+javascript",
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  specimen.it("v.media is the same scalar", () => {
+    specimen.expect(v.media().pattern).toBe(mime.MEDIA);
+  });
+});
+
#+end_src

// subsystems/typology/gestalten/belt/channel.js
const media = (written) => {
  const [essence, ...parameters] = written.split(";").map((piece) => piece.trim());
  return {
    essence: essence.toLowerCase(),
    parameters: Object.fromEntries(
      parameters.map((parameter) => {
        const [name, value] = parameter.split("=");
        return [
          name.toLowerCase(),
          value
            .replaceAll('"', "")
            .split(",")
            .map((piece) => piece.trim()),
        ];
      }),
    ),
  };
};

const within = (taken, given) =>
  taken.essence === given.essence &&
  Object.entries(taken.parameters).every(
    ([name, values]) =>
      !(name in given.parameters) ||
      given.parameters[name].every((value) => values.includes(value)),
  );

export const match = (channel, part) =>
  channel.type === part.type &&
  (!channel.mime ||
    ("mime" in part && channel.mime.some((taken) => within(media(taken), media(part.mime)))));

const named = (channel) => (channel.mime ? channel.mime.join(", ") : channel.type);

const WORDED = { in: "takes", out: "gives" };

const refused = (faculty, via, side, part) =>
  new Error(
    `[${faculty.type}] '${faculty.id}' ${WORDED[side]} no ` +
      `'${part.mime ?? part.type}' ${part.type} on ${via}: ` +
      `it ${WORDED[side]} ${faculty.channels[via][side].map(named).join(", ")}`,
  );

const PADDED = [
  [(data) => data.endsWith("=="), 2],
  [(data) => data.endsWith("="), 1],
  [() => true, 0],
];

const weight = (part) =>
  Math.floor((part.data.length * 3) / 4) - PADDED.find(([padded]) => padded(part.data))[1];

const bounded = (faculty, via, parts) => {
  for (const channel of faculty.channels[via].in) {
    const held = parts.filter((part) => match(channel, part));
    if ("count" in channel && held.length > channel.count)
      throw new Error(
        `[${faculty.type}] '${faculty.id}' takes at most ${channel.count} ${named(channel)} ` +
          `on ${via}: ${held.length} given`,
      );
    const heavy = "bytes" in channel && held.find((part) => weight(part) > channel.bytes);
    if (heavy)
      throw new Error(
        `[${faculty.type}] '${faculty.id}' takes at most ${channel.bytes} bytes of ` +
          `${named(channel)} on ${via}: ${weight(heavy)} given`,
      );
  }
  return parts;
};

const taken = (faculty, via, part) =>
  part.type === "alien" || faculty.channels[via].in.some((channel) => match(channel, part));

export const take = (faculty, via, parts) => {
  const stranger = parts.find((part) => !taken(faculty, via, part));
  if (stranger) throw refused(faculty, via, "in", stranger);
  return bounded(faculty, via, parts);
};

const UNITS = [
  [(bytes) => bytes >= 1048576, (bytes) => `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`],
  [(bytes) => bytes >= 1024, (bytes) => `${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} kB`],
  [() => true, (bytes) => `${bytes} bytes`],
];

const sized = (bytes) => UNITS.find(([fits]) => fits(bytes))[1](bytes);

const attached = (faculty, part) => ({
  type: "text",
  text:
    `[attached ${part.type} · file ${part.file} · ${part.mime} · ${sized(weight(part))} · ` +
    `${faculty.id} cannot read ${part.type}]`,
});

export const lower = (faculty, via, parts) =>
  take(
    faculty,
    via,
    parts.map((part) =>
      taken(faculty, via, part) || !("file" in part) ? part : attached(faculty, part),
    ),
  );

export const give = (faculty, via, part) => {
  if (part.type === "alien" || faculty.channels[via].out.some((channel) => match(channel, part)))
    return part;
  throw refused(faculty, via, "out", part);
};
#+end_src

// subsystems/typology/tests/gestalten/belt/channel.test.js
import { belt, specimen } from "@vivalence/typology";

const { match, lower, take, give } = belt.channel;

const file = { type: "audio", mime: ["audio/ogg", "audio/mpeg", "audio/mp4", "audio/aac"] };
const opus = { type: "audio", mime: ["audio/ogg;codecs=opus"] };
const live = { type: "audio", mime: ["audio/pcm;rate=16000;channels=1"] };
const heard = (mime) => ({ type: "audio", mime, data: "AAAA" });

const ear = {
  type: "verbatim",
  id: "nova-3",
  channels: { render: { in: [file], out: [{ type: "text" }] } },
};

const mind = {
  type: "dialogue",
  id: "opus",
  channels: {
    stream: {
      in: [{ type: "text" }, { type: "image", mime: ["image/png"], bytes: 3, count: 1 }],
      out: [{ type: "text" }],
    },
  },
};

const thrown = (act) => {
  try {
    act();
  } catch (fault) {
    return fault.message;
  }
};

specimen.describe("channel.match — a part against one channel", () => {
  specimen.it("a mime in the channel's list matches", () => {
    specimen.expect(match(file, heard("audio/ogg"))).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(match(file, heard("audio/mpeg"))).toBe(true);
  });

  specimen.it("a mime outside the list does not", () => {
    specimen.expect(match(file, heard("audio/amr"))).toBe(false);
  });

  specimen.it("a channel without parameters takes any parameter of its mime", () => {
    specimen.expect(match(file, heard("audio/ogg; codecs=opus"))).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(match(file, heard("audio/ogg;codecs=vorbis"))).toBe(true);
  });

  specimen.it("a parameter on the channel refuses a part that declares another", () => {
    specimen.expect(match(opus, heard("audio/ogg; codecs=opus"))).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(match(opus, heard("audio/ogg; codecs=vorbis"))).toBe(false);
    specimen.expect(match(opus, heard('audio/ogg; codecs="opus, vorbis"'))).toBe(false);
  });

  specimen.it("a part that declares no parameter passes a channel that names one", () => {
    specimen.expect(match(opus, heard("audio/ogg"))).toBe(true);
  });

  specimen.it("audio/pcm matches on rate and on channel count", () => {
    specimen.expect(match(live, heard("audio/pcm;rate=16000;channels=1"))).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(match(live, heard("audio/pcm;rate=44100;channels=1"))).toBe(false);
    specimen.expect(match(live, heard("audio/pcm;rate=16000;channels=2"))).toBe(false);
  });

  specimen.it("the kind first; a channel without mime takes every part of its kind", () => {
    specimen.expect(match({ type: "audio" }, heard("audio/amr"))).toBe(true);
    specimen.expect(match({ type: "image" }, heard("audio/ogg"))).toBe(false);
    specimen.expect(match(file, { type: "audio" })).toBe(false);
  });
});

specimen.describe("channel.take · lower · give — a faculty's side on one via", () => {
  specimen.it("take: a source the faculty lacks faults: faculty, format, what it takes", () => {
    specimen.expect(thrown(() => take(ear, "render", [heard("audio/amr")]))).toBe(
      "[verbatim] 'nova-3' takes no 'audio/amr' audio on render: " +
        "it takes audio/ogg, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/aac",
    );
    specimen.expect(take(ear, "render", [heard("audio/ogg; codecs=opus")])).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  specimen.it("lower: a file part the faculty lacks becomes one line of text", () => {
    const voice = { ...heard("audio/ogg; codecs=opus"), file: "01a1b1c0" };
    specimen.expect(lower(mind, "stream", [{ type: "text", text: "listen" }, voice])).toEqual([
      { type: "text", text: "listen" },
      {
        type: "text",
        text:
          "[attached audio · file 01a1b1c0 · audio/ogg; codecs=opus · 3 bytes · " +
          "opus cannot read audio]",
      },
    ]);
  });

  specimen.it("lower: the size reads in bytes, kB and MB", () => {
    const sized = (length) =>
      lower(mind, "stream", [{ ...heard("audio/ogg"), data: "A".repeat(length), file: "f" }])[0]
        .text.split(" · ")[3];
    specimen.expect([4, 24000, 3000000].map(sized)).toEqual(["3 bytes", "18 kB", "2.1 MB"]);
  });

  specimen.it("lower: a part with no file and no channel faults, never stringified", () => {
    specimen.expect(thrown(() => lower(mind, "stream", [heard("audio/ogg")]))).toBe(
      "[dialogue] 'opus' takes no 'audio/ogg' audio on stream: it takes text, image/png",
    );
  });

  specimen.it("more parts than a channel's count fault; so does one part over its bytes", () => {
    const pixel = { type: "image", mime: "image/png", data: "AAAA" };
    specimen.expect(thrown(() => take(mind, "stream", [pixel, pixel]))).toBe(
      "[dialogue] 'opus' takes at most 1 image/png on stream: 2 given",
    );
    specimen.expect(thrown(() => take(mind, "stream", [{ ...pixel, data: "AAAAAAAA" }]))).toBe(
      "[dialogue] 'opus' takes at most 3 bytes of image/png on stream: 6 given",
    );
    specimen.expect(take(mind, "stream", [pixel])).toEqual([pixel]);
  });

  specimen.it("give: a part the faculty did not declare faults", () => {
    specimen.expect(give(mind, "stream", { type: "text", text: "ciao" })).toEqual({
      type: "text",
      text: "ciao",
    });
    specimen.expect(thrown(() => give(mind, "stream", { type: "tool_use", id: "t1" }))).toBe(
      "[dialogue] 'opus' gives no 'tool_use' tool_use on stream: it gives text",
    );
  });

  specimen.it("an alien part passes both ways: it is the provider's own block", () => {
    const alien = { type: "alien", dialect: "anthropic", block: {} };
    specimen.expect(lower(mind, "stream", [alien])).toEqual([alien]);
    specimen.expect(give(mind, "stream", alien)).toBe(alien);
  });

  specimen.it("the parts are not mutated", () => {
    const voice = { ...heard("audio/ogg"), file: "01a1b1c0" };
    const parts = [voice];
    lower(mind, "stream", parts);
    specimen.expect(parts).toEqual([
      { type: "audio", mime: "audio/ogg", data: "AAAA", file: "01a1b1c0" },
    ]);
    specimen.expect(parts[0]).toBe(voice);
  });
});

#+begin_src js
// systems/runtime/tests/harness.filing.test.js
import { join } from "@std/path";
import { encodeBase64 } from "@std/encoding/base64";
import { sleep, specimen } from "@vivalence/typology";
import { create } from "./scenarios/cortex.js";
import { speechFaculty, textStream, textTurn } from "./scenarios/fixtures.js";

const BYTES = new TextEncoder().encode("OggS-a-voice-note");
const TAKEN = [{ type: "text" }, { type: "audio", mime: ["audio/ogg"] }];
const seen = [];

const witness = {
  type: "dialogue",
  id: "witness",
  tune: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
  context: 1000,
  channels: {
    stream: {
      in: TAKEN,
      out: [{ type: "text" }],
      via: async (request) => {
        seen.push(request);
        return textStream("heard")();
      },
    },
    render: {
      in: TAKEN,
      out: [{ type: "text" }],
      via: async (request) => {
        seen.push(request);
        return textTurn("heard");
      },
    },
  },
};

const ear = {
  type: "verbatim",
  id: "filing-ear",
  tune: [0.4, 0.5, 0.1],
  context: 0,
  channels: {
    stream: {
      in: [{ type: "audio", mime: ["audio/pcm;rate=16000;channels=1"] }],
      out: [{ type: "text" }],
      via: async function* ({ source }) {
        for await (const packet of source) {
          yield { event: "/turn/open", turn: { role: "user" } };
          yield { event: "/part/open", index: 0, part: { type: "text", text: "" } };
          yield { event: "/part/delta", index: 0, part: { text: packet.audio.data } };
          yield { event: "/part/close", index: 0 };
          yield { event: "/turn/close", turn: {} };
        }
      },
    },
  },
};

async function* microphone(words) {
  for (const word of words) yield { event: "/audio/packet", audio: { data: word, rate: 16000 } };
  await sleep.ms(400);
}

let scenario;
let directory;

const noted = async (thread) => {
  const mount = join(directory, `${thread.id}.ogg`);
  await Deno.writeFile(mount, BYTES);
  return scenario.entities.file.upload({
    mode: scenario.fixtures.dewey,
    path: `${thread.id}.ogg`,
    mount,
    mime: "audio/ogg; codecs=opus",
    hash: thread.id,
    bytes: BYTES.length,
    thread: thread.id,
  });
};

const handed = (file) => ({
  type: "audio",
  mime: "audio/ogg; codecs=opus",
  data: encodeBase64(BYTES),
  file: file.id,
});

const drained = async (packets) => {
  for await (const _packet of packets);
};

specimen.describe("harness filing — a file part reaches a faculty as its bytes", () => {
  specimen.beforeAll(async () => {
    directory = await Deno.makeTempDir({ prefix: "viva-filing-" });
    scenario = await create({ faculties: [witness, ear, speechFaculty()] });
  });

  specimen.afterAll(async () => {
    await scenario.orm.close();
    await Deno.remove(directory, { recursive: true });
  });

  specimen.beforeEach(() => {
    seen.length = 0;
  });

  specimen.it("/dialogue: the file part is handed; the stored turn keeps the file", async () => {
    const thread = await scenario.createThread();
    const file = await noted(thread);
    await scenario.dewey.harness.dialogue.render({
      thread: thread.id,
      id: "witness",
      parts: [{ type: "file", file: file.id }],
    });
    specimen.expect(seen[0].turns.at(-1).parts).toEqual([handed(file)]);
    scenario.em.clear();
    const stored = await scenario.entities.turn.history({ thread: thread.id });
    specimen.expect(stored[0].parts).toEqual([{ type: "file", file: file.id }]);
  });

  specimen.it("/object: a caller's file part is handed; its turns are not mutated", async () => {
    const thread = await scenario.createThread();
    const file = await noted(thread);
    const turns = [{ role: "user", parts: [{ type: "file", file: file.id }] }];
    await scenario.dewey.harness.object.render({ thread: thread.id, id: "witness", turns });
    specimen.expect(seen[0].turns.at(-1).parts).toEqual([handed(file)]);
    specimen.expect(turns).toEqual([{ role: "user", parts: [{ type: "file", file: file.id }] }]);
  });

  specimen.it("/call: a file part in the thread's history is handed to the mind", async () => {
    const thread = await scenario.createThread();
    const file = await noted(thread);
    await scenario.entities.turn.chain({
      role: "user",
      parts: [{ type: "file", file: file.id }],
      parent: null,
      thread: thread.id,
      mode: scenario.dewey.id,
    });
    await drained(
      await scenario.dewey.harness.call.stream({
        source: microphone(["ciao"]),
        thread: thread.id,
        id: "witness",
      }),
    );
    specimen.expect(seen[0].turns[0].parts).toEqual([handed(file)]);
  });

  specimen.it("a file of another thread is not handed", async () => {
    const thread = await scenario.createThread();
    const file = await noted(await scenario.createThread());
    const turns = [{ role: "user", parts: [{ type: "file", file: file.id }] }];
    let fault = null;
    try {
      await scenario.dewey.harness.object.render({ thread: thread.id, id: "witness", turns });
    } catch (thrown) {
      fault = thrown;
    }
    specimen.expect(fault).not.toBe(null);
    specimen.expect(seen).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});
#+end_src
